top_signals.title: UAE says one of its ships was targeted by missile as U.S.-Iran tensions over Strait of Hormuz remain high
top_signals.summary: Iran's military stressed that the crucial waterway would only be reopened when the U.S. accepts Iran's conditions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CEO Greg Abel Starts Making His Mark at Berkshire
top_signals.summary: Berkshire Hathaway stepped up spending under CEO Greg Abel, repurchasing about $4.5 billion of its shares while deploying billions more into investments. Bloomberg Intelligence and Senior P&C Insurance Equity Analyst Matthew Palazola is on Bloomberg This Weekend explaining to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Abel appears more focused on operations and putting Berkshire’s enormous cash reserves to work, marking an early shift from Warren Buffett’s final years at the helm. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Water utilities group partners with DEF CON offshoot for Water Watch Center
top_signals.summary: The National Rural Water Association and a group of cybersecurity experts have formed a program to help cash-strapped utilities face the increase in threats to their systems.
